name: Hanyū (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hanyū city emblem in black: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Hanyū, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 January 1955.

features.role: Hanyū city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character
